skillset.skill: 15s CT - 4300% Fire DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 30. If own HP is above 50%, increase own Arts by 50 instead.
skillset.arts:
25000% Fire DMG (PHY). For 15s, increase allies' Arts by 3/s (Type E) and Fire/Water allies' Arts by an additional 3/s (Type D/C).
Note: This unit's Arts Gen is Type E / D / C and will not stack with other Type E / D / C Arts Gen.
skillset.truearts: 80000% Fire DMG (PHY). 100% chance to inflict Paralysis for 6s. For 20s, reduce enemies' Fire RES and Water RES by 100%.
skillset.superarts: 230000% Fire DMG (PHY). Increase own ATK and DMG based on how high own HP is for the duration of Super Arts (MAX: 300%).

passive.ability1: Heal for 1% of own DMG dealt to enemies. Additionally, at Start of Battle, increase allies' Arts by 50. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Kyoko Sakura's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Kyoko Sakura's SP. Art is owned)
